en: Lifecycle
Priorities
Consumer value

lead.en: Prioritizes scope, roadmap, and consumer value of a data product. Distinct from domain ownership (purpose/access) and stewardship (definition/quality) — avoids three hats collapsing into one person by default.

en: One domain with a limited mart surface

quote.en: Decision rights beat job titles every sprint.

quote.en: If everyone owns the interface, nobody owns the interface.

quote.de: Owner ownen. Stewards stewarden. Spreadsheets paniken.

quote.de: Zweck und Zugriff — kein Backlog-Item.

quote.en: Access denied is a love language.

quote.en: Roadmap pressure is not a purpose decision.
quote.de: Roadmap-Druck ist keine Zweckentscheidung.

quote.en: Consumer delight ≠ domain free-for-all.

quote.de: Runtime ist Wahrheit. Folien sind Optimismus.

quote.en: Backup tested > backup promised.
quote.de: Backup getestet > Backup versprochen.
